name: Kathmandu
title: uPVC Windows & Doors in Kathmandu
description: Hi-Tech uPVC Profile Industries designs, fabricates, and installs made-to-measure uPVC windows, doors, and panels across Kathmandu — Tarakeshwar factory, Lambagar glass, Tokha workshop.
headline: uPVC built for Kathmandu light, dust, and monsoon.
body: From Budhanilkantha to Patan, Baneshwor to Tarakeshwar — we measure on site, extrude and assemble at our own factory, and fit with valley crews who know local openings.
bullets: Factory at Bihani Chowk, Tarakeshwar — profiles cut to the millimetre
Glass processing at Lambagar; fabrication support in Tokha
Sliding, casement, tilt & turn, French, folding, and wall panels
Free site measurement across the Kathmandu valley

faqs.question: Do you install uPVC windows across Kathmandu?
faqs.answer: Yes. Hi-Tech measures, manufactures, and installs across the Kathmandu valley — including Tarakeshwar, Tokha, Budhanilkantha, Baneshwor, Patan, and surrounding areas.

faqs.question: Where is the Hi-Tech uPVC factory?
faqs.answer: Our head office and factory are at Bihani Chowk, Tarakeshwar. We also operate Hitech Glass in Lambagar and a Hi-Tech uPVC Windows workshop in Tokha.

name: Pokhara
title: uPVC Windows & Doors in Pokhara
description: Made-to-measure uPVC windows, doors, and panels for Pokhara homes and projects — fabricated by Hi-Tech uPVC Profile Industries in Tarakeshwar and installed by our team.
headline: Valley-made uPVC for lakeside homes and hill projects.
body: Pokhara’s humidity, lake-side glare, and cool winters ask for sealed multi-chamber frames. We fabricate in Tarakeshwar and schedule measurement and installation for Pokhara and nearby districts.
bullets: Same factory quality as Kathmandu installs — one Hi-Tech standard
Energy-efficient glazing options for cooler mornings and wet seasons
French, sliding, and folding doors for terraces and lake views
Quote and WhatsApp support before we travel for measurement

faqs.question: Can Hi-Tech install uPVC in Pokhara?
faqs.answer: Yes. We serve Pokhara and surrounding areas with made-to-measure uPVC windows, doors, and panels. Start with a quote or WhatsApp message and we arrange site measurement.

faqs.question: Are Pokhara orders made in Kathmandu?
faqs.answer: All frames are fabricated at our Tarakeshwar factory in the Kathmandu valley, then installed on site in Pokhara by our fitting team.

name: Lalitpur
title: uPVC Windows & Doors in Lalitpur (Patan)
description: Made-to-measure uPVC windows, doors, and panels for Lalitpur and Patan homes — fabricated at the Hi-Tech uPVC factory in Tarakeshwar and installed by our valley team.
headline: Quiet, sealed uPVC for Lalitpur homes and apartments.
body: From Jhamsikhel and Sanepa to Imadol and Satdobato — Lalitpur’s busy roads and tight plots need windows that seal out noise and dust without bulky frames. We measure on site, fabricate in Tarakeshwar, and install with the same valley crew.
bullets: Free site measurement across Lalitpur and Patan
Double-glazed options to cut traffic noise on Ring Road sites
Slim sliding and casement profiles for apartment openings
Factory-made in Tarakeshwar — one Hi-Tech quality standard

faqs.question: Do you install uPVC windows in Lalitpur and Patan?
faqs.answer: Yes. Hi-Tech uPVC measures, manufactures, and installs across Lalitpur — including Patan, Jhamsikhel, Sanepa, Imadol, Satdobato, and nearby areas.

faqs.question: Can uPVC windows reduce road noise in Lalitpur apartments?
faqs.answer: Double-glazed uPVC windows with multi-point sealing noticeably reduce traffic and street noise compared with single-glazed aluminium or timber frames.

name: Bhaktapur
title: uPVC Windows & Doors in Bhaktapur
description: Made-to-measure uPVC windows, doors, and panels for Bhaktapur homes and new builds — fabricated by Hi-Tech uPVC in Tarakeshwar and installed across Bhaktapur district.
headline: Warm, low-maintenance uPVC for Bhaktapur builds.
body: Bhaktapur’s cold winter mornings and dusty dry season are hard on timber and single glass. Our multi-chamber uPVC frames hold warmth, never need varnish, and suit both new houses in Suryabinayak and Thimi and renovations nearby.
bullets: Free site measurement across Bhaktapur district
Multi-chamber frames that keep winter rooms warmer
Woodgrain finishes that suit traditional-style facades
No termites, rot, or annual painting

faqs.question: Do you serve Bhaktapur for uPVC windows and doors?
faqs.answer: Yes. We measure and install across Bhaktapur — including Suryabinayak, Thimi, Kausaltar, and nearby areas — with frames made at our Tarakeshwar factory.

faqs.question: Do you have woodgrain uPVC for traditional-style homes?
faqs.answer: Yes. Woodgrain foil finishes such as golden oak give a timber look without the termite, warping, or repainting problems of real wood.
